infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VisionGuide uses the camera to detect hazards, read signs and room numbers, and find entrances.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VisionGuide listens to your voice commands, like 'take me to Room 443B'.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VisionGuide uses your location for walking directions to your destination.
